summary: Healthcare applications in low-resource settings face challenges with data access and storage. The Android FHIR SDK addresses this issue by enabling offline-capable, mobile-first healthcare applications using the HL7 FHIR standard. This benefits healthcare professionals and patients in rural or underserved areas. The project's goal is to accelerate FHIR adoption, improving healthcare data management and interoperability. It targets the healthcare sector, specifically focusing on digital health and global health initiatives.
